mapper.insert: INSERT INTO audit_record ( audit_no, audit_type, business_id, applicant_id, title, content, attachments, current_status, current_admin_id, priority, submit_time, is_deleted, create_time, update_time ) VALUES ( #{auditNo}, #{auditType}, #{businessId}, #{applicantId}, #{title}, #{content}, #{attachments}, #{currentStatus}, #{currentAdminId}, #{priority}, #{submitTime}, 0, NOW(), NOW() )
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM audit_record WHERE id = #{id} AND is_deleted = 0
SELECT * FROM audit_record WHERE audit_no = #{auditNo} AND is_deleted = 0
mapper.update:
UPDATE audit_record
current_status = #{currentStatus}, current_admin_id = #{currentAdminId}, final_opinion = #{finalOpinion}, reject_reason = #{rejectReason}, finish_time = #{finishTime}, update_time = NOW()
WHERE id = #{id} AND is_deleted = 0
UPDATE audit_record SET current_status = #{currentStatus}, current_admin_id = #{currentAdminId}, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND is_deleted = 0

UPDATE audit_record SET current_status = #{currentStatus}, final_opinion = #{finalOpinion}, reject_reason = #{rejectReason}, finish_time = NOW(), update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND is_deleted = 0
mapper.select: SELECT ar.id, ar.audit_no AS auditNo, ar.audit_type AS auditType, ar.business_id AS businessId, ar.title, ar.content, ar.attachments, ar.current_status AS currentStatus, ar.priority, ar.submit_time AS submitTime, ar.finish_time AS finishTime, ar.final_opinion AS finalOpinion, ar.reject_reason AS rejectReason, ar.current_admin_id AS currentAdminId, ar.applicant_id AS applicantId, ar.create_time AS createTime, ar.update_time AS updateTime, u.username AS applicantUsername, u.name AS applicantName, u.avatar AS applicantAvatar, u.phone AS applicantPhone, a.name AS currentAdminName FROM audit_record ar LEFT JOIN user_info u ON ar.applicant_id = u.id LEFT JOIN admin_info a ON ar.current_admin_id = a.id WHERE ar.id = #{id} AND ar.is_deleted = 0

SELECT COUNT(1) AS totalCount, SUM(CASE WHEN current_status = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS pendingCount, SUM(CASE WHEN current_status = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS processingCount, SUM(CASE WHEN current_status = 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS approvedCount, SUM(CASE WHEN current_status = 3 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS rejectedCount, SUM(CASE WHEN DATE(submit_time) = CURDATE() THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS todayCount FROM audit_record WHERE is_deleted = 0

SELECT audit_type AS auditType, COUNT(1) AS count, SUM(CASE WHEN current_status IN (0, 1) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS pendingCount FROM audit_record WHERE is_deleted = 0 GROUP BY audit_type ORDER BY audit_type
